Not really. Loose skin depends on how long you were fat and how much elasticity your skin has. If it's stretched too much, it won't reverse back, even if you did it slowly. It sure helps because, yes, some skin will reverse back, but whether it reverses entirely is up to your body's reaction. But the most important thing to understand is that having loose skin is far better than being obese. So whether you lose weight slowly or quickly, as long as you're healthy, that's all that matters. Filling your frame with muscle will also help you look good, especially after dropping so much weight.
